content: To book, send your dates, room and number of guests to our host on LINE (@letschillbnb). The host replies within 2 hours (09:00 to 21:00) and confirms whether the room is free on those dates. This online agent cannot see bookings, so it cannot check or hold a room for specific dates.
Check-in is from 15:00 to 21:00. Check-out is by 11:00. If you will arrive after 21:00, please tell us by LINE before 18:00 on your arrival day.
No. 88, Nanwan Road, Hengchun Township, Pingtung County (屏東縣恆春鎮南灣路88號). Nanwan Beach is across the road.

From THSR Zuoying Station, take the Kenting Express bus 9188 (about 2 hours) and get off at the Nanwan stop; we are a 3-minute walk away. We also offer a pick-up service from Zuoying Station (an add-on, booked in advance).
Free parking for 6 cars in front of the building, first come first served. Scooter parking is free.
A 30% deposit by bank transfer within 3 days confirms a booking. The rest is paid at check-in by cash, credit card or LINE Pay.

14 or more days before check-in: full refund of the deposit. 7 to 13 days before: 50% refund. 6 days or less: no refund. If a land typhoon warning is issued for Hengchun on your check-in day, you may change the date or get a full refund.

Room prices are per room per night. Friday and Saturday nights use the weekend price; Sunday to Thursday nights use the weekday price. Children under 6 sharing a bed stay free and do not count toward the room capacity.
Breakfast is not included in the room price. It can be added for NT$250 per person per day, served from 07:30 to 09:30 in the lobby.
Pets are not allowed, except guide dogs.
Free Wi-Fi in every room and in the lobby.
Quiet hours are from 22:00 to 08:00. No smoking anywhere inside the building; please use the smoking area by the parking lot.
Beach towels, umbrellas and a shower by the entrance are free for guests. Please do not take room towels to the beach.
Free luggage storage at the front desk on your check-in day (from 10:00) and check-out day (until 18:00).
